Every expensive repair was a cheap noise three weeks earlier.

Fourteen months in, the {{{VEHICLE}}} will eventually make a sound it did not make before. The instinct is to turn the radio up. The instinct is wrong, and with a plan, it is also unnecessary.
Take it to an ASE-certified shop, book it through Openbay+ if you want the price posted first, and have the shop call Ascent before they do anything. If the cause is a covered failure, the repair is covered. If it is not, you paid for a diagnosis instead of a tow.

WHEN IT MAKES A NOISE
1: Note when it happens: cold, turning, braking, speed
2: Book a shop on Openbay+
3: Shop calls Ascent, 866-660-7003, before work
4: Covered failure: $100. Not covered: you still caught it early.

The plan pays for covered parts that fail. It does not pay for the extra damage caused by driving on a failed part for a month. Early is cheaper in every version of this story.

Book a look on Openbay+ -> {{{OPENBAY_URL}}}
Tell the shop there is a service contract before they start.

The radio trick has never once fixed a wheel bearing. We have looked into it.
